steps.description: Four classes represent type results. Literal tags select those types, and variable tags look up an existing environment entry.
The let case infers the initializer's type, copies the environment with that binding, and checks the body.
Addition accepts matching numeric types or two strings. Comparison requires matching types and produces TBool.
